name: 2D scene camera (push, whip, pull-back, drift)
description: An invisible null at the comp centre whose scale / position are keyed like a camera: a slow push-in across a shot, a 2-3 frame whip zoom on a beat, an eased pull-back, or a gentle drift. Apply it BEFORE the content and pass returns.cameraId as parentId to the content recipes so their root layers ride it. Masks are comp-space and do not follow it: keep pushes small (<= 1.1) on masked titles.
source: r04 S1 whip zoom 1 -> 1.47 -> 1.5 in 3 f at 60, pan, drift up
r06 S1-S3 camera null: zoom-out 1 -> 0.5 with [0.525, 0.498, 0.414, 0.911], drift, pan

mode.description: push = slow scale-in over the whole span; whip-in = snap zoom on a beat; pull-back = settle from a zoomed frame; drift = slow position move, no zoom.

x.description: Pivot x (default comp centre). Zooms scale around it.

from.description: Start scale (default: push 1, whip-in 1, pull-back 1.18, drift 1).

to.description: End scale (default: push 1.06, whip-in 1.45, pull-back 1, drift 1).

at.description: whip-in / pull-back: frames at 30 fps from start to the move.

frames.description: Move length, frames at 30 fps (default: push / drift = the whole span, whip-in 2, pull-back 22).

drift.description: Position travel in px over the move (drift mode; push adds a third of it).

lets.ML: frames == null ? (mode == 'whip-in' ? f(2) : mode == 'pull-back' ? f(22) : end - start) : f(frames)
